ALITA CHEAT SHEET

For people who will never read a manual. Look at the pictures. Click the same thing.

Ugh, fine. Pictures only. Wake me when it's answered.
1

JUST OPEN IT

Open your ALITA link; sign in with an invitation code or mailcode. B = map + Graph Chat, A/B = both chats.

That's it?!
2

KEY IN. EACH VISIT.

Paste your own OpenRouter key, hit Save. It stays only until you reload or close the page.

SAVE!
3

PICK A FLOWER

Each flower is a database. Click one or more. Pick none = search everything.

Too lazy? Skip it.
4

JUST ASK

Document Chat (A): type a normal question, press Send, lean back.

SEND!
5

CHECK THE RECEIPTS

Those little [1] [2] are sources. Click one to see the exact passage. Copy takes answer + sources.

Trust, but click.
6

WHO DID WHAT?

People, projects, methods, who cites whom: ask Graph Chat (B). It shows the path it followed.

7

POKE THE MAP

Hover a dot = peek. Click a dot = open the doc. Click a cluster = both chats only ask about that one.

Lost? Reset view.
8

3D JOYRIDE

Hit "3D · time". Fly: W A S D, leave: Esc. Too lazy to steer? "Fly through time".

9

ADMINS: FEED IT

Click then pick flower, kind, drop files. Readers and reviewers cannot upload.

STUCK?

Weird answer? Too many filters. Click Clear selection.

Chat confused? Click + New and ask again.

Lazy pro move: type @db:Magnolia right in your question.

ALITA can be wrong. That's why step 5 exists.
